**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive grant:** Section 1.4 (p0008–p0009) — HDI grants the Company access to and the right to use the hosting system, HDI software and Content administration tools. This is the only licence-type grant in our favour; the only other licence (p0038, our Marks to HDI) is non-exclusive and non-transferable and benefits us, so it was left alone.
- **Fails fallback:** the grant runs solely to "the Company" (defined at p0002 as The Deerskin Companies, Inc. alone, with no affiliate inclusion), and Section 10.3 expressly denies rights to "no other person," so affiliates have no path in.
- **Already met:** Section 10.3's successors-and-assigns language covers transfer to an M&A successor, so no operation was drafted for that element.
- **Not flagged:** nothing makes the grant revocable or suspendable at HDI's discretion; contractor coverage, perpetuity and irrevocability are preferred-level only and were not volunteered at the fallback target.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence after p0009 extending the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates on written notice — validated with `ok:true` and a clean minimality gate.
